basic_details.job_title: DLSA Sant Kabir Nagar Mediator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority Sant Kabir Nagar (DLSA Sant Kabir Nagar) has announced 4 vacancies for the Mediator post on a contract basis, with offline applications to be submitted on or before 23 October 2026 by registered post, speed post or by hand to the Office of District Legal Services Authority, District Court, Sant Kabir Nagar. Candidates must download the application format from the website of Allahabad High Court or Sant Kabir Nagar district court, fill it, and attach self-attested photocopies of identity card/Aadhaar card, registration certificate, and Bar Association identity

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Applicants must belong to one of the following categories: Advocates with a minimum of 10 years of practice in their respective courts, retired judicial officers, retired administrative officers, principals, teachers, bank employees, chartered accountants, social workers, professionals, or dispute resolution experts who possess capability and experience in resolving disputes.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the submission of offline applications followed by an interview for eligible candidates. The date of the interview will be published separately on the notice board and the district court website.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format downloaded from the official website. The completed application along with required self-attested photocopies must be submitted by registered post, speed post, or by hand to the Office of District Legal Services Authority, District Court, Sant Kabir Nagar.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for DLSA Sant Kabir Nagar Mediator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 23 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Is the engagement for the Mediator post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The notification specifies that 4 mediators are to be appointed at the mediation center, but specific contract duration or permanency details are not detailed beyond the establishment of the panel.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of their identity card or Aadhaar card, registration certificate, and Bar Association identity card along with the filled application format.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Mediator post?
faq.answer: Advocates with a minimum of 10 years of practice, retired judicial officers, retired administrative officers, principals, teachers, bank employees, chartered accountants, social workers, professionals, and dispute resolution experts with dispute resolution experience are eligible.
